c_dmu_legends.title: The Legends You'll Find in Dominaria United (2022-09-01)

c_pwg_one.title: Planeswalker's Guide to Phyrexia: All Will Be One

claims.subject: weatherlight
claims.summary: The skyship Weatherlight, its crew of heroes, and the Legacy were instrumental in thwarting Phyrexia's invasion of Dominaria.
claims.limitation: Profile-level summary; the Weatherlight Saga novels/comics (Weatherlight through Apocalypse) are not ingested.

claims.subject: karn
claims.summary: The Legacy was a collection of artifacts that included the Planeswalker Karn.
claims.limitation: Other Legacy components are not enumerated by the cited source.

claims.subject: weatherlight
claims.summary: The Weatherlight contained ancient magical technology that enabled the ship to planeswalk.
claims.limitation: Origin of that technology (Thran) is not stated in the cited source.

claims.subject: urza
claims.summary: Karn is a sentient silver golem created over 1200 years ago (relative to the profile) by the Planeswalker Urza.
claims.limitation: Absolute date and construction details not given.

claims.subject: karn
claims.summary: Karn created Mirrodin, an independent metallic plane with five colored suns.

claims.subject: karn
claims.summary: Old Phyrexia was destroyed but Karn became an unwitting carrier of its oil, and accidentally left a drop of glistening oil on Mirrodin's inner core.

claims.subject: glistening_oil
claims.summary: The oil slowly corrupted Mirrodin from the inside out; Mirrans became Phyrexians and the plane became New Phyrexia.
claims.limitation: Scars of Mirrodin story chronology is summarized, not ingested episode by episode.

claims.subject: yawgmoth
claims.summary: Yawgmoth was a medical genius from Dominaria.
claims.limitation: The Thran-era origin story (novel The Thran) is not ingested; 'medical genius' is the only biographical detail used.

claims.subject: yawgmoth
claims.summary: Yawgmoth planeswalked to Old Phyrexia and installed himself as its new ruler, the Father of Machines.

claims.subject: old_phyrexia
claims.summary: Old Phyrexia was an artificial plane created by an unknown Planeswalker; the creator is not identified.
claims.limitation: Do not name a creator from non-Wizards sources.

claims.subject: yawgmoth
claims.summary: Yawgmoth used the Phyrexians to launch repeated invasions of his home plane.

claims.subject: yawgmoth
claims.summary: Official summaries credit Yawgmoth's end differently: the ONE guide says he was slain by Karn and his allies; the 2022 Dominaria guide credits Gerrard with bringing about his defeat; the Urza profile (Pack B) says Urza and Yawgmoth perished together. All accounts are preserved.
claims.limitation: Accounts may be complementary rather than contradictory (shared final battle); the Apocalypse novel is not ingested, so the precise sequence is unresolved here.

claims.subject: old_phyrexia
claims.summary: Old Phyrexia was destroyed after Yawgmoth's defeat.
claims.limitation: The guide states Old Phyrexia was destroyed but does not explicitly tie the destruction to the same battle.

claims.subject: coalition
claims.summary: During the first Phyrexian Invasion, Dominaria's inhabitants formed the Coalition, an alliance spanning many species, peoples and nations.

claims.subject: jhoira
claims.summary: After rebuilding the skyship, Jhoira handed the captaincy to Shanna and retired to her workshop at the Mana Rig.
claims.limitation: The 2018 Return to Dominaria rebuild arc is not claim-extracted episode by episode.

claims.subject: shanna
claims.summary: Shanna took over as captain of the Weatherlight when Jhoira gave up control.

claims.subject: jhoira
claims.summary: When news of the Phyrexian invasion reached her, Jhoira joined the Coalition and serves as one of its leaders.

claims.subject: jodah
claims.summary: Jodah, an archmage over 4,000 years old, uses his reputation to rally allies to the Coalition's banner.

claims.subject: jodah
claims.summary: Jodah was born when 'his ancestor's war' had decimated Terisiare, implying the Brothers' War.
claims.limitation: The source does not name the war or the ancestor.

claims.subject: sheoldred
claims.summary: Praetor Sheoldred leads a new invasion of Dominaria.

claims.subject: raff_capashen
claims.summary: Raff Capashen is navigator and ship's mage for the Weatherlight.

claims.subject: house_capashen
claims.summary: House Capashen's heritage stretches from ancient Sheoltun nobility to the hero Gerrard.

claims.subject: urza;mishra
claims.summary: Urza and Mishra discovered ancient stones of power in the Caves of Koilos.
claims.limitation: Fills part of the Pack B Koilos gap; the powerstone split (Mightstone/Weakstone) is still not sourced.

claims.subject: powerstones
claims.summary: The stones of power were found in the Caves of Koilos.

claims.subject: urza
claims.summary: At the end of the Brothers' War, Urza discovered the plane of Phyrexia.

claims.subject: dominaria
claims.summary: Dominaria was the epicenter of temporal-planar fractures; a handful of powerful Planeswalkers mended the rifts.
claims.limitation: Participants in the Mending are not named in the cited source.

claims.subject: teferi
claims.summary: Teferi phased his homeland out of time, later lost his spark, and new threats inspired him to reclaim it.
claims.limitation: Homeland not named in the profile (do not assert Zhalfir from this source).

claims.subject: elesh_norn
claims.summary: The Machine Orthodoxy, under Elesh Norn, sought a leader to replicate the glory days of Yawgmoth; Norn later embraced the role of Mother of Machines.
